endpoint: Past-30-day cigarette smoking reported at the next scheduled PATH survey
prediction_time: End of starting interview, using baseline answers only

classifier.status: Retained unchanged; development-selected/calibrated, final-test evaluation pending

probability_validation_status: Development only; final-test and new-user validity not established
interval_description: Next scheduled interview; individual elapsed time is unavailable and survey intervals vary.
timing_unavailable_message: Elapsed-time risks and estimated relapse dates are unavailable. This research classifier predicts smoking reported at the next survey, not when smoking will resume.
historical_recency_role: last_cigarette_recency_days is an optional baseline history predictor, not follow-up time or time until relapse
negative_outcome_meaning: No cigarette smoking in the observed follow-up 30-day window; not continuous abstinence or an event-free survival interval
missing_followup_meaning: Unobserved outcome; not sustained abstinence or a fabricated censoring time
claim_limits: No one-, two- or three-year risks from wave labels or classification probabilities
No exact, midpoint or interview-endpoint relapse dates
No time-since-quitting substituted as future event time
No continuous abstinence or persistent-relapse conclusion from a follow-up snapshot
No personal confidence percentage, causal effect, clinical validity or national representativeness claim
